audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..3].side read "Zyra" and phases[4..6].side read "Skill", but content win[] (matching the packet levelChart and Yuumi's 51.23% WR over 1546 games) says Yuumi wins levels 1-5 and Zyra wins first item and 2+ items — the reverse of the early split.
audit.why: Zyra's early damage is dodgeable skillshots (Deadly Spines, Grasping Roots) and slow-activating plants that attached healing absorbs; she only out-bursts sustain once Liandry/Lost Chapter lands and a root chains her full combo, matching content's own whys[].
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..3].side = "Yuumi" and phases[4..6].side = "Zyra", with rewritten why lines grounded in her kit (see edits).

audit.why: content spikes[] correctly identify the level-2 skirmish, level-6 R being dodgeable without E, and the first-item Liandry burst spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file flags that Zyra can cancel Yuumi's channeled Final Chapter (R) with any of Garden of Thorns (P), Rampant Growth (W), or Grasping Roots (E) — none of these named as R-cancel threats anywhere on the page.
audit.why: This is a real, kit-sourced fact (all three flagged hardCC in champ-data/_kits/zyra.json, Yuumi's R flagged channel/interruptible) that changes when Yuumi should cast her ultimate against this enemy.

edits.after: Her chip cannot out-trade your empowered Q plus continuous heals.

edits.after: Your sustain erases her plant poke before she spikes on items.

edits.after: Her R is a dodgeable delayed knockup your heals negate — but her spike looms.

edits.before: - Zyra Grasping Roots: matchup-defining — The root blooms the garden on the held — dodge it behind minions. It writes your spacing rules. - W attach (untargetability) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Zyra Grasping Roots: matchup-defining — the root blooms the garden on the held; dodge it behind minions. - Garden of Thorns (P), Rampant Growth (W) and Grasping Roots (E) can all cancel your channeled R, so only cast Final Chapter once her CC is spent. - W attach (untargetability) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades.

notes: Level chart was fully reversed between layers before this proposal; content win[]/whys[] were already correct and full-layer side/why rewritten to match. Folded the missing-interactions entry (three separate CC sources that cancel Yuumi's R) into breakdown.cooldowns.
